test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 Nov, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

The captain said to the soldiers, “Follow the enemy.”

options.text: The captain said his soldiers to follow the enemy.
The captain commanded his soldiers to follow the enemy.
The captain charged his soldiers to followed the enemy.
The captain requested his soldiers to follow the enemy.

solution:
The option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech is ‘2’ i.e. "The captain commanded his soldiers to follow the enemy."
